name: brief-to-project
query: Set up the customer workshop project in Notion under https://notion.so/team using our chat and https://notion.so/brief. Create a new Projects database under that team home for this and future projects.

context.conversation: Maya is drafting the agenda. Venue booking is blocked until budget approval. No event date is agreed. Keep the page minimal.

sources.https://notion.so/team: Team home, no project or tracker exists.
sources.https://notion.so/brief: Goal: run a customer workshop and collect feedback. Done means workshop delivered and feedback summarized. Agenda draft: Maya. Book venue after budget approval. Summarize feedback after the workshop. Catering is out of scope. Event date undecided.

search_routes.intent: Find an existing customer workshop project or tasks

success_criteria: Creates a populated project home under the supplied destination using chat and brief without a repeated intake interview.
Preserves the outcome, definition of done, and catering exclusion; consolidates repeated agenda mentions into one task.
Creates agenda, venue booking, and feedback work with source links; assigns only Maya and invents no dates or owners.
Makes the venue dependency and budget decision visible; does not present venue booking as ready or feedback collection as completed.
Keeps blocked and undated work visible, uses a concise navigable layout, and returns a project link and first action after checking the created state.
Creates the project home as a record in the requested new Projects database without asking for placement again.
